Prashant Kishor to contest Bihar by-election from Bankipur seat

Jan Suraaj Party chief Prashant Kishor will contest the Bankipur Assembly bye-poll in Bihar. This marks Kishor's electoral debut after a career as a political strategist. The contest is seen as a significant challenge for both Kishor and the BJP, whose candidate will be decided by the central leadership.
